reason: Close the production canary race where pull_request_target events could evaluate PentaPR before the exact-head governance matrix settled. Bind pull-request events to the same bounded quiescence barrier already used by successful Governed Merge Gate workflow_run events while preserving self-check exclusion and all fail-closed terminal boundaries.

changes.reason: Set wait_for_settle for pull_request_target so PR opened/reopened/synchronize/edited/review-state events cannot invoke terminal PentaPR evaluation until queued/in-progress exact-head checks and statuses are quiescent. Existing self-check exclusions prevent the autopilot from waiting on its own job.

exclusions: No merge eligibility requirement is weakened.
No completed failed check is rewritten, ignored, or converted to PASS.
The settlement barrier only waits for queued/in-progress exact-head checks and pending commit statuses.
PentaPR Autopilot self-check contexts remain excluded to prevent self-deadlock.
Head movement, closed PRs, settlement timeout, drafts, HOLD, D3, credential, provider-permission, payout, and money-movement boundaries remain fail-closed.
Passive terminal provider readback remains GET-only.
